AWS SAA
Serve files from S3 worldwide with low latency while keeping the bucket private. What do you use?
CloudFront in front of the bucket with Origin Access Control (OAC); a bucket policy allows only that distribution.
AWS SAA
RDS Multi-AZ vs read replicas: what is each for?
Multi-AZ: high availability, a synchronous standby that takes over on failure. Read replicas: asynchronous copies that scale reads and can be promoted.
AWS SAA
Orders arrive in sudden spikes and the processing workers can't keep up. How do you decouple them?
Put an SQS queue between the web tier and the workers; workers poll at their own pace and can scale on queue length.
AWS SAA
One event must reach several independent consumers. Which pattern?
Fan-out: publish to an SNS topic subscribed by several SQS queues (one per consumer).
AWS SAA
Cheapest storage for archives you rarely read, where retrieval within 12–48 hours is fine?
S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
AWS SAA
Data with unknown or changing access patterns: which S3 storage class?
S3 Intelligent-Tiering, which moves objects between tiers automatically.
AWS SAA
EC2 instances in a private subnet need to download updates from the internet. How?
A NAT gateway in a public subnet, and a route 0.0.0.0/0 → NAT gateway in the private subnet's route table.
AWS SAA
Security group vs network ACL?
Security group: instance level, stateful, allow rules only. NACL: subnet level, stateless, allow and deny rules evaluated in number order.
AWS SAA
An app on EC2 needs to read from S3. How do you give it access without storing keys?
Attach an IAM role to the instance (instance profile); the SDK picks up temporary credentials automatically.
AWS SAA
Make a stateless web app highly available and scale with demand.
An Application Load Balancer in front of an Auto Scaling group spread across multiple Availability Zones.
AWS SAA
Where do you keep user session data so web servers can stay stateless?
In ElastiCache (Redis) or DynamoDB, not on the instances.
AWS SAA
Route /api to one service and /images to another behind one entry point. Which load balancer?
Application Load Balancer (layer 7), with path-based routing rules.
AWS SAA
You need static IP addresses and very high-performance TCP/UDP load balancing. Which load balancer?
Network Load Balancer (layer 4).
AWS SAA
DynamoDB reads must drop to microseconds for a read-heavy app. What do you add?
DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX), an in-memory cache for DynamoDB.
AWS SAA
Order these DR strategies from cheapest/slowest to most expensive/fastest recovery: pilot light, multi-site, backup & restore, warm standby.
Backup & restore → pilot light → warm standby → multi-site (active-active).
AWS SAA
Encrypt S3 data at rest and keep an audit trail of every key use. Which option?
SSE-KMS: keys in AWS KMS, and each key use is logged in CloudTrail.
AWS SAA
Users in account A need to manage resources in account B. What's the secure way?
An IAM role in account B with a trust policy for account A; users call sts:AssumeRole for temporary credentials.
AWS SAA
Many Linux EC2 instances need one shared file system. Which service? And for Windows?
Amazon EFS (NFS) for Linux; Amazon FSx for Windows File Server for Windows (SMB).
AWS SAA
A database on EC2 needs consistently high IOPS on block storage. Which volume type?
Provisioned IOPS SSD (io2/io1); gp3 if the IOPS need is moderate, since it lets you set IOPS separately from size.
AWS SAA
What is EC2 instance store, and when is it a bad choice?
Very fast storage physically attached to the host; data is lost when the instance stops or fails. Bad for anything that must persist.
AWS SAA
A batch job can be interrupted and restarted. Cheapest EC2 pricing?
Spot Instances (up to ~90% off), with checkpointing so interrupted work resumes.
AWS SAA
A workload runs 24/7 for the next three years. How do you cut the EC2 bill?
Savings Plans or Reserved Instances (1- or 3-year commitment).
AWS SAA
If the main site fails, users should land on a static 'maintenance' site in S3. Which Route 53 feature?
Failover routing policy with a health check on the primary record.
AWS SAA
Send each user to the AWS Region that answers them fastest. Which Route 53 routing policy?
Latency-based routing.
AWS SAA
Build a serverless REST API with a database. Which services?
API Gateway → Lambda → DynamoDB.
AWS SAA
What is the maximum run time of a single Lambda invocation?
15 minutes. Longer jobs belong in ECS/Fargate, AWS Batch or Step Functions.
AWS SAA
Instances in a private subnet must reach S3 without a NAT gateway or internet access. How?
A gateway VPC endpoint for S3 (also exists for DynamoDB, at no extra cost).
AWS SAA
Connect dozens of VPCs and an on-premises network without a mesh of peerings. Which service?
AWS Transit Gateway (hub and spoke).
AWS SAA
On-premises needs a private, consistent-bandwidth link to AWS. Which service, and what's a quick backup?
AWS Direct Connect; a Site-to-Site VPN as backup (quick to set up, over the internet).
AWS SAA
Who deleted that security group? Which service tells you, and which ones cover metrics and configuration history?
CloudTrail records API calls (who did what). CloudWatch: metrics, logs, alarms. AWS Config: resource configuration history and compliance.
AWS SAA
Store database credentials with automatic rotation. Which service?
AWS Secrets Manager (built-in rotation, e.g. for RDS). Parameter Store has no built-in rotation.
AWS SAA
Block SQL injection and cross-site scripting before they reach your app. What do you use? And against DDoS?
AWS WAF on CloudFront, the ALB or API Gateway. AWS Shield (Standard is automatic; Advanced for extra protection).
AWS SAA
Name three advantages of Aurora over standard RDS MySQL.
Up to 15 low-lag read replicas, storage that grows automatically (to 128 TiB), and 6 copies of the data across 3 AZs with fast failover.
AWS SAA
Kinesis Data Streams vs Amazon Data Firehose?
Data Streams: real-time, you write the consumers and control retention. Firehose: fully managed, near-real-time delivery into S3, Redshift or OpenSearch, no consumer code.
AWS SAA
How do you protect S3 objects from accidental deletion, and how do you make them unchangeable for compliance?
Versioning (plus MFA Delete). For write-once-read-many: S3 Object Lock.
AWS SAA
Users on several continents need low-latency reads and writes to the same DynamoDB table. What do you use?
DynamoDB Global Tables (multi-Region, multi-active).
AWS SAA
How long can RDS keep automated backups, and what do they allow?
Up to 35 days, with point-in-time restore to any second in that window.
AWS SAA
CloudFront signed URLs vs signed cookies: when do you use each?
Signed URL: access to one file. Signed cookies: access to many files without changing their URLs.
AWS SAA
ECS on Fargate vs ECS on EC2?
Fargate: serverless, you don't manage instances, pay per task. EC2 launch type: you manage the cluster instances, more control and possibly cheaper at steady scale.
AWS SAA
You must move 100 TB to AWS over a slow internet link. What's the practical option?
AWS Snowball Edge: a physical device shipped to you, loaded locally, shipped back.
